```{r Sample data to data frame}
sample_data <- ps_analysis_2@sam_data
sample_data <- data.frame(sample_data)

nrow(sample_data) #237



```


```{r birth outcomes data frame}
#combining large for gestational age into the "normal" category
#defining SVN to exclude those with miscarriages etc. 
sample_data <- sample_data %>% 
  mutate(Percential_weight.GA_2 = case_when(Percential_weight.GA == "normal" | Percential_weight.GA == "LGA" ~ "Normal", Percential_weight.GA == "SGA" ~ "SGA")) %>% 
   mutate(SVN = case_when(Percential_weight.GA_2 == "SGA" | Birth_weight_cat == "Low Birth Weight" | GA_birth_binary == "Preterm" ~ "SVN", .default = "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(Single_outcome_SVN = case_when(Born_Alive == "1" & Percential_weight.GA_2 == "Normal" & Birth_weight_cat == "Normal Weight" & GA_birth_binary == "Term" ~ "Healthy", Born_Alive == "1" & SVN == "SVN" ~ "SVN", .default = "Other"))


```


```{r}
richness <- estimate_richness(ps_analysis_2) 
rownames(richness) <- gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(richness))
richness <- richness %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Sample.ID")

evenness <- evenness(ps_analysis_2, index = c("pielou"))
evenness <- evenness %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Sample.ID")


sample_data_2 <- left_join(sample_data, richness) %>% 
  left_join(evenness) %>% 
  filter(Single_outcome_SVN != "Other") %>% 
  filter(Twins == 2)
nrow(sample_data_2) #213
```

## Alpha Diversity

```{r ALPHA DIVERSITY: RICHNESS}

# "Observed" (the total number of ASVs identified per sample) is used as the measure of richness.
wilcox.test(Observed ~ Single_outcome_SVN, data = sample_data_2)

# plot
ggplot(sample_data_2, aes(x = Single_outcome_SVN, y = Observed, color = Single_outcome_SVN)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Observed", title = "Microbial Richness") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        #aspect.ratio = 1, 
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 20), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 18)) +
   stat_compare_means(aes(), label.x = 2, label.y = 0.8)


#ggsave(here("results/figures/richness-observed_SVN_p-value.png"), width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```

```{r ALPHA DIVERSITY: EVENESS}

# plot
```

## Beta Diversity 

```{r BETA DIVERSITY: BRAYS}

sample_data(ps_analysis_2) <- column_to_rownames(sample_data, var = "Sample.ID")

ps_analysis_3 <- ps_analysis_2 %>%
  subset_samples(Single_outcome_SVN != "Other" & Twins == "2") 

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1) 
set.seed(3754) 

# Ordinate relative abundances using Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity
ps_analysis_prop <- transform_sample_counts(ps_analysis_3, function(ASV) ASV/sum(ASV))
#ps_analysis_prop <- ps_filter(ps_analysis_prop, SVN == "Normal" | SVN == "SVN")

ord_nmds_bray <- ordinate(ps_analysis_prop, method = "NMDS", distance = "bray")

# Visualize by Non-metric Multidimensional Scaling (NMDS)
ordplot_bray <- plot_ordination(ps_analysis_prop, ord_nmds_bray, color = "Single_outcome_SVN") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity", color = "Group") +
  #scale_color_manual(values = c("#8080ff", "#ff8080", "#808080" )) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, 
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 18)) 

ordplot_bray




#ggsave(here("results/figures/beta-diversity-bc_SVN.png"), width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300)

meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_analysis_prop))

adonis2(
  distance(ps_analysis_prop, method = "bray") ~ Single_outcome_SVN,
  data = meta
)


# Add ellipses
ordplot_bray +
  stat_ellipse(type = "norm") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))  +
  coord_fixed()+
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = -1, label = "p = 0.042", color = "black")
#p=0.042
```



## Organize data: Phylum
NOTE: Many of the functions used are duplicated for the purpose of later graphs being able to be grouped by feature of interest when desired. 

```{r ORGANIZATION OF COMMUNITY COMPOSITION: PHYLUM}
#merging samples by feature of interest
merged_ps_phylum_p <- merge_samples(ps_analysis_3, "Single_outcome_SVN")

#agglomerating asvs to desired taxa level
merged_ps_taxa_1_p <- tax_glom(ps_analysis_3, "Phylum", NArm = TRUE)
merged_ps_taxa_2_p <- tax_glom(merged_ps_phylum_p, "Phylum", NArm = TRUE)

#calculating relative abundance
normalized_ps_taxa_relabun_1_p = transform_sample_counts(merged_ps_taxa_1_p, function(OTU) OTU/sum(OTU) * 100)
normalized_ps_taxa_relabun_2_p = transform_sample_counts(merged_ps_taxa_2_p, function(OTU) OTU/sum(OTU) * 100)


#converting to a data.frame
taxa_relabun_1_p <- psmelt(normalized_ps_taxa_relabun_1_p) 
taxa_relabun_2_p <- psmelt(normalized_ps_taxa_relabun_2_p) 


#converting taxa level of interest to character data type
taxa_relabun_1_p$Phylum <- as.character(taxa_relabun_1_p$Phylum)
taxa_relabun_2_p$Phylum <- as.character(taxa_relabun_2_p$Phylum)


#Calculating medians of relative abundance across the taxa level of interest
medians_1_p <- plyr::ddply(taxa_relabun_1_p, ~Phylum, function(x) c(median=median(x$Abundance)))
medians_2_p <- plyr::ddply(taxa_relabun_2_p, ~Phylum, function(x) c(median=median(x$Abundance)))


#identifying taxa of <= 1% relative abundance
remainder_1_p <- medians_1_p[medians_1_p$median <= 1,]$Phylum
remainder_2_p <- medians_2_p[medians_2_p$median <= 1,]$Phylum


#renaming taxa <= 1% abundance
taxa_relabun_1_p[taxa_relabun_1_p$Phylum %in% remainder_1_p,]$Phylum <- 'Other <1%'
taxa_relabun_2_p[taxa_relabun_2_p$Phylum %in% remainder_2_p,]$Phylum <- 'Other <1%'


```





## Statistics

```{r Statistics}

# Extract p values between groups for each phyla
phylum_pvals <- list() # Make empty list for p values.

for (x in taxa_relabun_1_p$Phylum) {
  phylum_pvals[[x]] <- dplyr::filter(taxa_relabun_1, Phylum == x) %>%
    wilcox.test(Abundance ~ Single_outcome_SVN, data = .) %>%
    .$p.value
}


# Make a table of p values
wilcox_phyla <- data.frame(unique(taxa_relabun_1_p$Phylum), 
                           unlist(phylum_pvals))

wilcox_phyla <- wilcox_phyla %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(wilcox_phyla$unlist.phylum_pvals., 
                                    method = "fdr")) 


#write.csv(wilcox_phyla, 
          #here("results/tables/phylum_wilcox_SVN.csv"), 
          #row.names = FALSE)

```
